description:
• Brand introduction: AETHER (AYE-thur) was founded in 2019 with a mission to provide pragmatic and accessible ways for people to leverage 'bio-hacking', and to optimize their brain and mental state for peak vitality and performance. We are strong believers of meditation and believe that every moment and every breath is an opportunity to re-ground and refocus the mind towards whatever direction you need it to go. We set out to make a conveineint and easy to use product that combined meditation, aromatherapy, and nootropics - the result is our flagship AETHER Inhaler.

• Product description: AETHER is the the world's first peak performance nasal inhaler. Our proprietary 'aroma-nootropic' blend of potent menthol and nine powerful essential oils is designed to instantly wake you up, help you breathe, and optimize brain function. Every ingredient in AETHER is 100% all natural and has been scientifically studied to promote focus, memory, cognition, and overall brain health. We pack it all inside of a convenient inhaler tube that can go with you anywhere, works instantly, and will lasts for weeks. It also smells great!

• USP (Unique Selling Point): Ultra long lasting, scientifically backed ingredients, no added flavoring or fillers, convenient, refreshing, clears sinuses, made in the USA, free shipping, money back guarantee.


• Payment terms: Will be payed through Paypal at the end of every week.

• Other information: We are excited to work with creators and affiliates who are passionate about our mission and product. AETHER caters to a lot of different niches including health and wellness, fitness, gaming, self improvement, etc. and we are always looking for new ways to represent our product and resonate with different audiences. AETHER is a premium yet relatively low priced item and is designed for affiliates to be able to sell a lot of them quickly and easily. At 18% per unit commision we hope to make it highly lucrative and worth your while to become an affiliate, however we will be working with you guys and consistently paying attention to feedback in order to adjust if needed and make it a win-win-win for you, us, and the customer.

Thanks for your interest in AETHER!
